title: Direct versus generated numerical evaluation
question: Does generated numerical evaluation repay preparation for the actual small-point scientific workload?
method: Compare direct SymPy with NumPy-backed lambdify for three real expressions at twelve and twelve hundred points, CSE disabled/enabled.
conclusion: Retain direct evaluation for current small scientific comparisons. The bounded generated kernels agreed but do not qualify complete complex, restriction and unavailable-value semantics. Larger repeated numeric workloads remain a separate qualification opportunity.
